lounges.name: Club Aspire Lounge (Terminal 5) — closed, No1 Lounge coming soon
lounges.notes: Closed. Operator No1 Lounges: the Club Aspire T5 booking page returns 404 (2026-11-20); the operator's Heathrow page lists 'No1 Lounges formerly known as Club Aspire coming soon at Heathrow Terminal 5', and its T5 lounge page says the lounge is closed while a new flagship No1 Lounge is created, opening early Spring 2027. Last published from-price was £40 per adult. No price or Priority Pass access while closed.
